steps.fact: Contract MSA-OAK-2018 names counterparty Oakfield Logistics GmbH.
The billing referent left denotes Oakfield Logistik GmbH as the billed name.
Commercial notes state Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH and that Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
Company registry row HRB 88421 lists Oakfield Logistik GmbH as the registered name.
The unchanged HRB 88421 across the rebrand establishes that Oakfield Logistics GmbH (contract counterparty) and Oakfield Logistik GmbH (billing name) are the same legal entity.

support_claim: The contract counterparty Oakfield Logistics GmbH and the billing name Oakfield Logistik GmbH are the same legal entity because the packet documents a 2023 rebrand with unchanged Handelsregister number HRB 88421.
